samir_sales: Customer (FinReg) wants BYOK + HSM-backed keys for the POC. They asked for brief answers we can paste into the SIG/CAIQ. Quick help?
kevin_sec: We support BYOK. For hosted API we integrate with customer KMS (no plaintext key export). For Private we can attach customer-managed HSMs (FIPS 140-2 L3) or use our HSM-backed key store.
maria_soleng: I can draft a short written response + sample config. Do they also want key escrow / split-key assurances?
samir_sales: Yes — they specifically asked about escrow, dual-control, and proof that keys never leave customer control when BYOK is used. Also asked how rotation works without downtime.
kevin_sec: We do NOT escrow customer keys by default. For dual-control, recommend HSM with role separation + quorum policies. For BYOK: customer provides KMS key URI/credentials and we use envelope encryption (service never holds plaintext key). For rotation: we use key versioning + envelope keys so rotation is an additive operation, no service downtime.
alex_infra: Example snippet for Private deploy (can drop into CAIQ response):
```
kms_provider: external_gcp
provider_config:
  key_uri: projects/PROJ/locations/global/keyRings/RING/cryptoKeys/KEY
  access_role: serviceAccount:redwood-infra@proj.iam.gserviceaccount.com
rotation_policy:
  mode: customer-managed
  rotation_period: 90d
  zero_downtime: true
```
kevin_sec: For hosted BYOK flows we'll need: customer KMS key resource id, a service account for encryption calls (roles: cryptoKeyEncrypterDecrypter), and attestation that key policy disallows export. For HSM-backed private installs we request HSM certs/attestation.
maria_soleng: I'll add short bullet answers for the CAIQ items: key custodianship, key generation/escrow, rotation, backup & recovery, logging. Also point them to SOC2 annex and KMS access controls.
samir_sales: They want an explicit line for "we never escrow keys unless customer requests and signs escrow SLA" — can we say that?
kevin_sec: Yes. Phrase it: "By default Redwood does not escrow customer-managed keys. Escrow or split-key arrangements are available as a contractual option and require documented approval and technical controls"
security-bot: Please create an eng-security ticket: POC-BYOK-FINREG and attach the draft CAIQ mapping + any HSM attestation docs.
samir_sales: I'll open the ticket now and ping the customer for their KMS key URI + whether they require escrow.
maria_soleng: I'll upload a one-page POC checklist and the sample config to the ticket. Also include a short snippet for audit evidence: "key access events logged to audit stream, retained 13 months".
kevin_sec: One more: for rotation with zero downtime describe envelope steps: create new key version -> update key URI mapping -> background re-encrypt existing prefixes -> roll traffic. We can include a short diagram if they ask.
samir_sales: Timeline: POC starts next Tue. Anything blocking?
kevin_sec: Need the customer's KMS details and HSM attestation (if they require HSM). Also confirm VPC peering for Private. If BYOK hosted, give service account + IAM role.
samir_sales: Got it. Creating ticket and copying CAIQ draft. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
maria_soleng: I'll push the CAIQ bullets + config to the ticket by EOD.
kevin_sec: I'll attach a short HSM acceptance checklist and the standard BYOK wording for contracts.
security-bot: Reminder: include a link to docs in the ticket: https://docs.redwood.ai/security/kms-and-byok
samir_sales: Awesome — closing this thread once ticket is created.
